rubric_items.reason: Each of the six acceptance criteria maps to at least one REQ. AC5 is split into REQ-9 to REQ-12. The 'spot long-unseen patients' motivation sits under Out of scope with a reason.
Previous F-1 is fixed. REQ-13 now covers only the list ask, and the own-page rule is moved to Out of scope with a reason. Each REQ is one behaviour a tester can check.
Every known REQ cites a ticket line or a baseline section. REQ-4 is correctly marked assumed, and its basis is the glossary definition of Completed. Nothing is invented.
The ticket does not clash with the baseline. AC6 agrees with the data-protection rule, and the hospital time zone comes from the baseline constraints.
Three questions, none blocking, each with real options and a default. Product questions go to the product owner and the glossary question goes to the tech lead.
Readable overall. The REQ-12 statement still ends with an awkward, cut-off ticket fragment, and claims C6 and C7 are still declared but never used.
